READ N
IF N MOD 2 = 0 THEN
  WRITE "Even"
ELSE
  WRITE "Odd"
ENDIF
END
LARP stands for Logic of Algorithms for Resolution of Problems. It lets learners run algorithms, observe how different inputs affect outputs, and practise writing and improving algorithms.

LARP stands for Logic of Algorithms for Resolution of Problems. It is an interactive tool for learning how algorithms work by running them and observing results. It helps learners understand algorithms, see how inputs affect outputs, and practise writing and improving algorithms.

LARP helps learners understand computational thinking by letting them run algorithms, see how inputs affect outputs, and refine the steps. For example, they can test an even-or-odd algorithm with different numbers and improve its decision or output if needed.
